name: Adam "EvilPacket" Baldwin
biography: Adam Baldwin has over 10+ years of mostly self-taught computer security experience and currently is the Chief Security Officer at &yet. He at one time possessed a GCIA and if his CPE's are up to date should still have a CISSP. Prior to starting at &yet, Adam operated a security consultancy, nGenuity and worked for Symantec. Adam is a minor contributor to the W3AF project, creator of the DVCS pillaging toolkit, helmet: the security header middleware for node.js, and has previously spoken at DEF CON, Toorcon, Toorcamp, Djangcon, and JSconf. Twitter: @adam_baldwin
